name: How long does interior door casing installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does interior door casing installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard interior door casing usually takes between one to two hours to measure, cut, fit, nail, and prep. However, total project time depends on wall conditions and whether painting or caulking is part of the scope. If rough framing is out of plumb or existing drywall is uneven—common in older remodels or basement finishing—extra time is spent planing jambs or scribing trim to ensure tight joints. A whole-house trim replacement typically takes several full working days.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing casing on a single interior door usually takes one to two hours, though uneven drywall, custom miters, caulking, and painting can extend the overall timeline.
